input.quote: 13. NON-SOLICITATION OF EMPLOYEES. Neither party shall, during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination, solicit for hire as an employee, consultant or otherwise any of the other party's personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services, without such other party's express written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: Section 13 binds Clear Capital as well as RadialSpark, so it deviates from our preferred position of no non-solicit on the Customer. It is, however, already close to our fallback: mutual, one year, limited to personnel with direct involvement in the Services, and solicitation-only (no no-hire). The only missing element is the customary carve-out for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, so the minimal edit adds that exclusion rather than deleting the clause.

proposal.summary: Add general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs to the mutual non-solicit
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The mutual non-solicit is already limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for one year, so we have added the customary carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches rather than deleting the clause. Our position is no non-solicit on the Customer, but we can live with this narrow, time-limited mutual version with these exclusions.

ops.oldText: which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
ops.newText: which shall not be unreasonably withheld. Nothing in this section shall restrict either party from (i) placing general advertisements or other solicitations of employment not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or (ii) hiring or engaging any person who responds to such a general solicitation or who approaches such party on an unsolicited basis.
